main:1.text: Outlaws from the West is the first storyline mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. Half frozen, close to death, and on the run, the Van der Linde gang find shelter in an old abandoned mining town. Dutch, Arthur, and Micah head out to look for supplies.

main:2.text: Enter, Pursued by a Memory is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. John Marston has not returned from an earlier scouting trip. Arthur Morgan and Javier Escuella ride out into the snow to look for him. Arthur exits one of Colter's cabins and enters another to find the rest of the group huddled for warmth. As he approaches to check on them, Abigail approaches him.

main:3.text: Looking for information on the O'Driscolls' planned train job, Dutch leads the gang to attack their camp at Ewing Basin. Arthur enters the men's shack at Colter and finds Micah Bell and Bill Williamson arguing. The fight almost turns violent before Dutch enters and scolds the pair, saying that Colm O'Driscoll is the one who needs hitting.

main:4.text: The Aftermath of Genesis is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. With the gang low on supplies and starving, Mr. Pearson sends Arthur and Charles out hunting. In Colter's makeshift kitchen, Pearson complains to Arthur that they do not have enough food for the entire group, and that people will start to starve.

main:5.page: Who the Hell is Leviticus Cornwall?
main:5.text: Who the Hell is Leviticus Cornwall? is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. In need of money, and with the plans and explosives stolen from the O'Driscolls' camp, the gang rides out to rob Leviticus Cornwall's private train. Dutch, Arthur and the gang prepare to rob a private train owned by Leviticus Cornwall.

main:6.text: Eastward Bound is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. It is the final mission of Chapter 1. With renewed strength and the weather finally stable, the gang rides down from the mountains to set up camp at Horseshoe Overlook. After the gang decides to move east to Horseshoe Overlook, Arthur gets on a wagon with Hosea, and the rest of the gang gets on wagons and horses for the ride.

main:7.text: Who is Not Without Sin is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. Arthur goes to find out what Reverend Swanson is doing at Flatneck Station. Arthur arrives at Flatneck Station to look for Reverend Swanson. He finds him beyond intoxicated, playing poker with two men named Luther and Marvin. After he passes out, Luther asks Arthur to play the Reverend's hand.

main:8.page: Exit Pursued by a Bruised Ego
main:8.text: Exit Pursued by a Bruised Ego is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. After spotting a huge bear up by the Dakota River, Hosea and Arthur ride out and track it. Hosea tells Arthur in camp he plans on going hunting. Arthur agrees to go with him, and the two decide to take a black Shire horse to Valentine to sell. After Arthur sells or keeps the horse, he can buy a new horse.

main:9.text: The Spines of America is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. To prove their business credentials to the Emerald Ranch fence, Seamus, Arthur, and Hosea attempt to rob a stagecoach from Old Bob Crawford at Carmody Dell. Arthur will arrive at Emerald Ranch. Hosea is seen talking to Seamus. Hosea greets Arthur and introduces Seamus as their new prospective business partner.

main:10.text: Polite Society, Valentine Style is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. In search of new leads for the gang, Karen, Tilly and Mary-Beth convince Arthur and Uncle to ride out to Valentine with them. Arthur wakes Uncle up in camp while he's sleeping. After pointing out Uncle's constant laziness, Arthur tells him to get in the wagon as they need to get some things in Valentine.

main:11.text: Good, Honest, Snake Oil is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. Following a tip from the Valentine Sheriff, Arthur attempts to capture and turn in Benedict Allbright, a wanted criminal, out near the Dakota River. Following Uncle's advice, Arthur enters the sheriff's office in Valentine.

main:12.text: Americans at Rest is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. Bill starts a brawl in Smithfield's Saloon in Valentine as Javier, Charles and Arthur attempt to charm the locals. The player can find Javier at the bar speaking to a pair of women with Charles, after which Arthur promptly scares them away with rudeness. Arthur, Javier, and Charles have a drink and wait for Bill at the bar.

main:13.text: The First Shall Be Last is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. Following a tip-off on Sean's whereabouts, Arthur, Trelawny, Javier and Charles track Ike Skelding's bounty hunters up the Upper Montana River and attempt to rescue Sean. Arthur arrives at Charles and Javier's camp in a clifftop, just north of Blackwater. He joins the two on the cliff edge, where they are examining the high security in the town.

main:14.text: Paying a Social Call is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. Under the threat of torture, Kieran leads Arthur, John and Bill out to Six Point Cabin where he claims Colm O'Driscoll is holed up. Arthur confronts Kieran, who's been tied to a tree in camp, about the O'Driscolls. Bill and Dutch approach, and they decide to threaten Kieran.

main:15.page: We Loved Once and True I & II
main:15.text: After receiving a letter from Mary Linton, Arthur Morgan heads to Chadwick Farm to hear what she has to say. In camp, Susan Grimshaw will inform Arthur that Mary sent a letter from Valentine. It is revealed the letter was picked up by one of the girls in camp, who was recognized by Mary as one of the gang members.

main:16.page: We Loved Once and True I & II
main:16.text: After receiving a letter from Mary Linton, Arthur Morgan heads to Chadwick Farm to hear what she has to say. In camp, Susan Grimshaw will inform Arthur that Mary sent a letter from Valentine. It is revealed the letter was picked up by one of the girls in camp, who was recognized by Mary as one of the gang members.

main:17.page: We Loved Once and True III
main:17.text: After finding Jamie in Cumberland Forest with the Chelonian religious order, Arthur tries to convince him to return to Mary. When Arthur finds Jamie with the Chelonians, they form a shell of safety around themselves. Arthur asks the Chelonians if he could speak with Jamie, who is surprised to see him and Arthur tells him that Mary is worried about him.

main:18.text: John and Arthur discuss the final plans before the train job. At camp, Arthur informs John that the oil wagon required for the train robbery has been delivered to the drop-off point and that they are now ready to rob the train. Arthur suggests that they should take another gang member, recommending Charles. John goes to find him, and tells Arthur to meet him at the wagon's location when he can.

main:19.text: Arthur steals an oil wagon to use in the train job being planned by John. As part of the plan to rob a train with John Marston, Arthur Morgan travels to Cornwall Kerosene & Tar to steal an oil wagon that will be used during the robbery to stop the train. Arthur manages to take the wagon, and delivers it to Old Trail Rise, where it will remain until "Pouring Forth Oil IV".

main:20.text: John and Arthur discuss the final plans before the train job. At camp, Arthur informs John that the oil wagon required for the train robbery has been delivered to the drop-off point and that they are now ready to rob the train. Arthur suggests that they should take another gang member, recommending Charles. John goes to find him, and tells Arthur to meet him at the wagon's location when he can.

main:21.text: Pouring Forth Oil IV is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. Blocking the tracks with the heavy oil wagon, Arthur, John, Charles and Sean board the train and rob valuables from the rich passengers and baggage car. Arthur arrives at the stolen oil wagon and finds that Sean is already there, practicing his quickdraw with bottles, wanting to show he could do well in combat.

main:22.text: A Fisher of Men is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. Arthur does a favor for Abigail and takes Jack out on a fishing trip. Arthur speaks to Abigail in camp, who asks him to do something fun with Jack, as he seems rather bored. Arthur is reluctant at first, but soon agrees. He heads over to Jack and greets him as he is playing in the grass. He invites Jack to come fishing with him.

main:23.text: The Sheep and the Goats is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. Arthur helps John with a plan to rustle a herd of sheep and sell them at auction in Valentine. After selling the sheep, Arthur, John, Dutch and Strauss are confronted by Leviticus Cornwall and his henchmen, which turns into a shootout.

main:24.text: A Strange Kindness is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. It is the final mission of Chapter 2. Wanting the gang to lie low after the trouble in Valentine, Dutch asks Arthur and Charles to scout out a new camp location at Dewberry Creek. After getting involved in a shootout in Valentine, Arthur rides back to camp to find the gang packing up.

main:25.page: Money Lending and Other Sins I & II
main:25.text: At the camp, Strauss asks Arthur to retrieve money from three debtors that owe him money. Arthur must collect debts from ranch hand Chick Matthews, Polish smallholder farmer Mr. Wróbel, and ranch maid Lilly Millet. Leopold Strauss greets Arthur at the camp and asks Arthur to help him with his loaning business. He tells Arthur to collect the debts from three people. Chick will be located at Guthrie Farm.

main:26.page: Money Lending and Other Sins I & II
main:26.text: At the camp, Strauss asks Arthur to retrieve money from three debtors that owe him money. Arthur must collect debts from ranch hand Chick Matthews, Polish smallholder farmer Mr. Wróbel, and ranch maid Lilly Millet. Leopold Strauss greets Arthur at the camp and asks Arthur to help him with his loaning business. He tells Arthur to collect the debts from three people. Chick will be located at Guthrie Farm.

main:27.page: Money Lending and Other Sins III
main:27.text: Money Lending & Other Sins III is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. Arthur attempts to reclaim a debt from Thomas Downes but finds him to be destitute. Thomas Downes previously borrowed money from Leopold Strauss, who sends Arthur to collect the money. Arthur arrives at the Downes Ranch to reclaim the debt. He encounters Downes in the garden, and confronts him.

main:28.text: A Quiet Time is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. Arthur takes Lenny for a quiet drink in Valentine to help calm him down after learning of Micah's arrest in Strawberry. Lenny arrives back at camp with the news that Micah was arrested in Strawberry for murder and that Sheriff Hanley is going to hang him. Dutch instructs Arthur to rescue Micah later and take Lenny into Valentine to calm him down.

main:29.text: Blessed are the Meek? is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. With Micah due to be hanged for a double murder near Strawberry, Arthur, on Dutch’s orders, attempts to break him out of jail. Arthur arrives in Strawberry, with Micah in prison. He speaks to Sheriff Hanley, pretending to be a bounty hunter who is looking for the O'Driscolls, but Hanley refuses to release Micah. After exiting, Arthur hears Micah yelling.

main:30.text: An American Pastoral Scene is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. Following a tip-off, Arthur and Micah rob a banking stagecoach. Arthur meets Micah at his camp near Strawberry, where Micah asks for his assistance in robbing a banking coach heading towards Strawberry, as a way to repay Arthur for his help in escaping jail.

main:31.text: Further Questions of Female Suffrage is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. To get her out of camp for a while, Arthur takes Sadie into Rhodes to collect supplies. Arthur comes across Pearson and Sadie having a heated argument. Sadie is discontent with having to stay in camp all day and do nothing but cook, stating that when her husband was alive, they shared the chores around their ranch.

main:32.text: Trelawny invites Arthur to see a discouraged worker at Rhodes post office about any available stagecoaches to rob. Arthur speaks to Trelawny at camp, who asks him to come to Rhodes to speak to a teller at the post office, who will be able to provide Arthur with tips about stagecoaches worth stealing.

main:33.page: A Short Walk in a Pretty Town
main:33.text: A Short Walk in a Pretty Town is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. Arthur, Micah, Bill and Sean go to meet some of the Gray boys in Rhodes to discuss a security job. Arthur meets the other three gang members in Rhodes for the “job”, although both he and Sean are deeply suspicious. Before they can voice any more concerns, they are suddenly ambushed by the Grays.

main:34.text: Blood Feuds, Ancient and Modern is a mission in Red Dead Redemption II. Suspecting it was Catherine Braithwaite who kidnapped Jack, the van der Linde gang ride to Braithwaite Manor to get him back. Upon returning to camp after the events in Rhodes, Arthur learns from Abigail that Jack has disappeared. The gang quickly determines that the Braithwaites took him as revenge for the gang stealing their prized horses.

main:35.text: The New South is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. The three men ride out of camp with the intent on going on a fishing trip. Not long after leaving camp, the men encounter Archibald MacGregor and Leigh Gray - the town's deputy and sheriff respectively - transporting a wagon of captured criminals. Dutch spots Trelawny in the back small cell in the back of the wagon, and asks why he is there.

main:36.page: The Course of True Love I
main:36.text: Dutch asks you to sniff around Caliga Hall to see what you can find out about the Grays. Arthur will first ride to Caliga Hall, where he will go to the front entrance of the property. The guards stop him, but after telling them that Leigh Gray permitted him to look around, they let him through. He then heads to the front steps, and finds a servant who he will question about the family.

main:37.page: The Course of True Love II
main:37.text: Beau Gray asks Arthur to deliver a letter to Penelope Braithwaite at Braithwaite Manor. Arthur will first ride to Braithwaite Manor, where he will attempt to sneak undetected to the back of the manor, where Penelope is. After reaching Penelope, Arthur will deliver her Beau's letter, and she will give you one of her own. You will once again sneak out of the manor, and deliver it to Beau.

main:38.page: The Course of True Love III
main:38.text: At the request of Beau, Arthur drives Penelope and other protesters through Rhodes as they participate in a women's suffrage rally lead by Olive Calhoon. After delivering Penelope's letter to Beau, he will grow alarmed, due to reading that she is planning on joining a march for the women's suffrage movement.

main:39.text: American Distillation is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. Arthur, Dutch and Bill become temporarily deputized citizens of the Scarlett Meadows Sheriff's Office as they help Archibald shut down a moonshine distillery and steal a wagon-load of the Braithwaites' moonshine.

main:40.text: An Honest Mistake is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. Uncle receives a tip-off and rides off with Arthur, Charles and Bill to rob a wagon carrying payroll. In camp, Molly O'Shea calls Arthur over to talk to him about Dutch. However, they are quickly interrupted by Uncle, who has received a tip-off about a supply wagon which is allegedly unguarded.

main:41.text: Advertising, The New American Art is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. Catherine Braithwaite pays Hosea and Arthur to head into Rhodes and hand out the stolen moonshine for free at the local saloon.

main:42.text: Magicians for Sport is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. Arthur and Charles go to track down Trelawny at his rental caravan in Rhodes. Remembering Trelawny's warnings about bounty hunters in the area, Arthur goes to speak with Dutch, who brushes it off as most likely a rumor, but nonetheless asks him and Charles to go check on Trelawny, as they haven't heard from him for some time.

main:43.text: The Fine Joys of Tobacco is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. Working with the Braithwaites, Arthur and Sean drive to Caliga Hall with the remaining moonshine and attempt to use it to burn the Grays' tobacco fields. Arthur arrives at Braithwaite Manor and tells the guards he has business with Catherine Braithwaite, so the guards let him in.

main:44.text: To get back at the Braithwaites, Tavish Gray asks Arthur, John and Javier to steal prized horses from Braithwaite Manor that he claims will sell for $5000. Arthur, John, and Javier group at the stables at Caliga Hall, where they are tasked by Tavish Gray to steal the Braithwaites' prized horses. The three make their way to the south side of Braithwaite Manor, where they are stopped by a guard.

main:45.text: Preaching Forgiveness as He Went is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. Following a lead about the Lemoyne Raiders sitting on a pile of weapons, Lenny and Arthur ride out deep into the woods towards Shady Belle. Lenny calls over Arthur in camp, telling him that he has heard of a manor called Shady Belle deep in the woods used by the Lemoyne Raiders.

main:46.page: Money Lending and Other Sins IV
main:46.text: Leopold Strauss wants Arthur to retrieve some money from Winton Holmes, an unemployed refinery worker, and from Gwyn Hughes, an apprentice undertaker. Gwyn will be located at an Undertaker (Mortician's) in Rhodes doing woodworking on a coffin. Arthur threatens Gwyn for the money and he explains that he can retrieve it, though "the morality of the matter is a little confusing".

main:47.text: Sodom? Back to Gomorrah is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. With the heat in Valentine having died down, Bill decides it's finally time to hit the bank. Karen causes a distraction while Arthur handles the vaults. While in camp at Clemens Point, Bill asks Arthur to speak with him. Informing Arthur that him and Karen have planned to rob the bank in Valentine, Bill tells Arthur to come along.

main:48.text: Blessed are the Peacemakers is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. Suspecting a trap, Micah asks Arthur to observe an arranged meeting between Dutch and Colm O'Driscoll from afar. Pearson met some O'Driscolls on the road who said they wanted to arrange a parley. Hosea calls it a trap, but Micah seems to think it is worth looking into and helps convince Dutch to go.

main:49.text: The Battle of Shady Belle is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. It is the final mission of Chapter 3. John and Arthur clear out the last remaining Lemoyne Raiders from Shady Belle before the gang relocate their caravan there.

main:50.text: The Joys of Civilization is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. Having just arrived in Saint Denis, Dutch and Arthur ask around the Bastille Saloon for information on Angelo Bronte. Arthur arrives at the saloon, and someone aims a gun at his head telling him to surrender. However, it is just Dutch having a bit of fun. He and Arthur talk about the city and how the bar should have some leads about Angelo Bronte.

main:51.text: No, No and Thrice, No is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. Susan and Arthur head to the Foreman Brothers' hideout to rescue Tilly, who has been kidnapped. In camp, Arthur greets Mary-Beth and the two talk while having a smoke. Susan Grimshaw interrupts the conversation and tells Arthur that Tilly has been taken by the Foreman Brothers.

main:52.text: Horsemen, Apocalypses is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. While planning the Saint Denis trolley robbery, Dutch notices a wave of O'Driscolls attacking the camp, but not before displaying Kieran's corpse. Dutch asks Arthur to talk to him about the trolley robbery that Bronte tipped him off about. Arthur asks if it will be just the two of them, but Dutch tells them they'll need a third.

main:53.text: Urban Pleasures is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. After receiving a tip from Angelo Bronte about a trolley station in Saint Denis holding a large amount of cash, Dutch, Arthur and Lenny meet to rob it. Arthur meets Dutch and Lenny in an alley across from the trolley station. Dutch explains that once they get enough money, he plans to have the gang go to either Australia or Tahiti for a better future.

main:54.text: Country Pursuits is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. Before they can rob the Saint Denis bank, Dutch convinces Arthur that they must kill Angelo Bronte. They visit Thomas, a local fisherman, to procure a skiff for the assault on Bronte's mansion.

main:55.page: Revenge is a Dish Best Eaten
main:55.text: Revenge is a Dish Best Eaten is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. Gang members Dutch van der Linde, Arthur Morgan, John Marston, Bill Williamson, and Lenny Summers attack Bronte's mansion from the river to get rid of the threat of Bronte's men and to take revenge for the trolley station setup. The gang lands at the pier near Bronte's manor, and hop the wall into Bronte's front yard.

main:56.page: Angelo Bronte, A Man of Honor
main:56.text: Angelo Bronte, A Man of Honor is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. Arthur, John, and Dutch head to Angelo Bronte's mansion to get Jack back. Bronte asks the gang to clear out the local graveyard of thieves in return for Jack. Arthur meets Dutch and John in the park, across the street from Angelo Bronte's house.

main:57.text: The Gilded Cage is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. The gang attend a party hosted by the Mayor of Saint Denis. While at the party, they meet with Bronte, and look for job opportunities. At Shady Belle, Arthur speaks with Hosea before Dutch appears, saying that they need to go and buy themselves some proper clothing for Mayor Lemieux's garden party that Bronte invited them to, much to Arthur's disbelief.

main:58.text: A Fine Night of Debauchery is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. While at the Mayor's party, the Van der Linde gang learned of a poker tournament being held on the Grand Korrigan riverboat at the docks in Saint Denis. Leopold Strauss and Josiah Trelawny fix a game so Arthur Morgan can win big on the tables. Arthur meets Trelawny in Saint Denis.

main:59.text: Fatherhood and Other Dreams is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. Mary asks Arthur for help with her father, who has become consumed by a gambling addiction. Arthur must retrieve a valuable family heirloom Mary's father has sold off. Arthur receives a letter from Mary Linton, asking him to come and meet her in Saint Denis. Arthur later finds her at the hotel, and, after talking, she asks for help with her father.

main:60.text: Dutch mentioned that the gang might be able to help Evelyn Miller with lobbying officials in Saint Denis on behalf of Rains Fall, the Native American Chief, so Arthur goes to meet him. After seeing Rains Fall, Eagle Flies and Evelyn Miller at Saint Denis Mayor Henri Lemieux's party, Arthur visits them outside the Saint Denis courthouse.

main:61.text: American Fathers II is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. Arthur meets Eagle Flies outside Cornwall Kerosene & Tar and prepares to break in to steal a report on the oil reserves at the Wapiti Indian Reservation. Arthur meets up with Eagle Flies near the oil fields. Eagle Flies suggests that, in order to get into the refinery unnoticed, Arthur could try hiding in one of the wagons that often enter it.

main:62.text: Brother Dorkins asks Arthur to investigate a nearby shop suspected of acting as a front for human trafficking. While walking in Saint Denis, Arthur encounters a monk named Dorkins. Dorkins asks Arthur to donate money to the church, and he can either agree to donate or refuse. Dorkins will then ask him to go to the local fence, who he believes is illegally trafficking children from the Spanish isles.

main:63.page: Brothers and Sisters, One and All
main:63.text: Brothers and Sisters, One and All is a Stranger mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. A street kid steals Sister Calderón's crucifix. Arthur chases the kid throughout Saint Denis. After Arthur retrieves the crucifix, he runs into Edith Downes, who sets the law on him. Arthur arrives at a small church where Brother Dorkins and Sister Calderón are teaching some street children to read.

main:64.page: Money Lending and Other Sins V
main:64.text: Leopold Strauss wants the player to collect another overdue debt from a fisherman by the name of Algie Davison. Once Arthur arrives at Catfish Jacksons, he finds Algie sleeping near the water. Algie takes Arthur inside his home to give him the money. In the kitchen, he orders his son Nate to serve a drink to them, while he looks for a box of money under the sink.

main:65.text: Banking, The Old American Art is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. It is the final mission of Chapter 4. The gang prepare to rob the bank in Saint Denis as one final score that would allow them to retire. In order to fund their escape overseas and retirement from the life of crime, the gang prepare for one last job: robbing Lemoyne National Bank in Saint Denis.

main:66.text: Welcome to the New World is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2 which begins Chapter 5. Having survived the shipwreck, and washed ashore on Guarma, Arthur begins searching for the gang. On the shore of a sandy beach on a tropical island, Arthur wakes up, distraught and alone with no food or water. He has no idea where he is and begins walking along the beach.

main:67.text: With the help of a local, Gloria, Dutch and Arthur infiltrate Fussar's compound to rescue Javier. Arthur meets Dutch at a narrow ledge in a cliff. Dutch hands Arthur a flaming torch and they slowly make their way across the cliff. Arthur asks where they are going to go after leaving Guarma and Dutch says that they will head back to Saint Denis in the US, as that is the least place anyone will expect them to go.

main:68.text: In order to secure safe passage off the island, Arthur has agreed to rescue some local workers for Hercule and Leon. In the jungle, Arthur comes across a hanged person and a dart hits his neck. He pulls it off but collapses to the ground. Arthur wakes up tied to a chair and his captor, a tall man called Angel, pulls a bag off his head. Angel punches Arthur to wake him up.

main:69.text: Hell Hath No Fury is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. The gang meets Hercule at the fortress of Cinco Torres, and prepare to clear the waters around the island so they can safely depart for America. Arthur arrives at the fortress to find Dutch and the gang arguing with Hercule over the boat he promised them.

main:70.text: Arthur and the gang must destroy the gun batteries on the coast and rescue the ship captain, in order to leave the island. While Bill is left to guard the recovering Javier Escuella, Arthur, Micah and Dutch go with Hercule Fontaine to destroy the gun batteries that would prevent their escape.

main:71.text: Arthur heads for Shady Belle to try to track down the rest of the gang. Arthur boards the boat heading from Guarma back to the United States. He is instructed by Dutch to ride to Shady Belle and look for any sign of the gang when they reach the country.

main:72.text: Arthur is reunited with the gang at Lakay. Milton arrives with his Pinkertons, and attacks the camp. After Arthur finds the letter from Sadie at Shady Belle, he heads to the location described in the letter near Lakay. Upon arrival, he is greeted by the others and given a drink.

main:73.text: Dutch sends Arthur and Charles to Beaver Hollow to find a new location for the gang's camp. After the gang are attacked by Pinkertons, Dutch realizes that they need to move, and because they can no longer travel any further east, they must go north instead. Arthur and Charles ride to Roanoke Ridge (or go by canoe if the player wishes) and eventually arrive at Beaver Hollow.

main:74.text: Once Arthur arrives near the quest's area, in Saint Denis, he (will dismount if he's on a horse and) suddenly starts coughing heavily until he passes out. He wakes up to find a stranger dragging and helping him to the local doctor's office, where he is greeted by a spooked receptionist, prompting her to call on doctor Joseph R. Barnes, who brings him into his surgery room.

main:75.text: Icarus and Friends is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. Sadie's contact, Arturo Bullard, agrees to take Arthur in his hot air balloon to scout out the Sisika Penitentiary. Arthur arrives at Doyle's Tavern in Saint Denis to meet Sadie, in order to discuss how to rescue John Marston from Sisika Penitentiary.

main:76.text: Do Not Seek Absolution I is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. This mission can be completed in both Chapter 5 and Chapter 6. It will not be available if Arthur has low Honor. Edith Downes tells Arthur that her son, Archie, is working at the Annesburg Mine. Arthur heads to the mine, to find Archie being goaded by the foreman, Mr. Dockery.

main:77.text: Do Not Seek Absolution II is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. Unwilling to accept Arthur's money, Edith Downes continues to sell her body. Worried for his mother's safety, Archie Downes asks Arthur to head to Willard's Rest to look for her. Arthur returns to Archie shortly after saving him from the abuse he was facing at the mine, to see if he was able to convince his mother to leave Annesburg with him.

main:78.page: The Course of True Love IV
main:78.text: At Beaver Hollow, Arthur receives a letter from Penelope Braithwaite. Arthur reads the letter he received, which turns out to be a request from Penelope Braithwaite. Penelope asks Arthur to help her run away with Beau, and states that she is at a cabin at the back of Braithwaite Manor. Arthur travels to the cabin and locates Penelope. After starting conversation with her, the next quest will automatically begin.

main:79.page: The Course of True Love V
main:79.text: Arthur tries to help Penelope Braithwaite and Beau Gray escape their families once and for all. After showing up at Braithwaite Manor, Penelope tells Arthur that she and Beau are planning on running away to Boston together. Beau is waiting at the train station in Rhodes, but she needs Arthur to escort her there on account of her not being allowed to leave the manor. Arthur agrees to do so.

main:80.page: Money Lending and Other Sins VI & VII
main:80.text: Leopold Strauss wants the player to collect two debts, one from J. John Weathers and another from Arthur Londonderry. Arthur finds Weathers at Three Sisters and demands the debt from him, but Weathers doesn't have any money. Weathers offers Arthur his wagon supplies, which is meant to last through the winter. However, a number of US Army soldiers arrive to kill Weathers, who deserted from the army.

main:81.page: Money Lending and Other Sins VI & VII
main:81.text: Leopold Strauss wants the player to collect two debts, one from J. John Weathers and another from Arthur Londonderry. Arthur finds Weathers at Three Sisters and demands the debt from him, but Weathers doesn't have any money. Weathers offers Arthur his wagon supplies, which is meant to last through the winter. However, a number of US Army soldiers arrive to kill Weathers, who deserted from the army.

main:82.text: Visiting Hours is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. Arthur and Sadie row to Sisika Island to break John out of prison. When arriving at Copperhead Landing, Abigail asks Arthur and Sadie if she could join them in rescuing John, but they refuse, saying that she would just become another thing to worry about. She reluctantly agrees, and thanks them both.

main:83.text: Just a Social Call is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. Arthur meets Dutch and Micah in Annesburg where they are planning to confront Leviticus Cornwall. Arthur arrives in Annesburg to meet Micah and Dutch, for something to do with Cornwall.

main:84.text: A Rage Unleashed is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. Eagle Flies and the gang launch a raid on an army boat, to reclaim horses stolen from the Wapiti Reservation. In camp, Arthur approaches Reverend Swanson, and the two have a brief conversation. They are quickly interrupted by Dutch, who calls Arthur over to him. Dutch tells him that the gang will go north to New York before heading to the tropics.

main:85.text: Goodbye, Dear Friend is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. With Colm O'Driscoll under arrest, Sadie, Arthur and Dutch head to Saint Denis to watch him hang. News reaches the gang that Colm is to be hanged.

main:86.text: Archeology for Beginners is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. Arthur visits Rains Fall in Wapiti and they travel to a sacred Native American site in the Grizzlies East. After agreeing with Charles Smith to help Rains Fall, Arthur travels to the Wapiti Indian Reservation to see him. Once there, he is invited into Rains Fall's tent.

main:87.text: Colonel Henry Favours is redirecting smallpox vaccines away from the Wapiti Indian Reservation to punish the Wapiti Indians for the recent unrest. Captain Lyndon Monroe requests Arthur's help to steal the vaccines from the U.S. Army. After promising to help Captain Monroe, Arthur goes to the Wapiti Indian Reservation to meet him.

main:88.text: The Fine Art of Conversation is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. Arthur attends a truce meeting between Colonel Favours and Rains Fall, where Rains Fall hopes to negotiate peace. While in camp, Arthur comes across Trelawny preparing to leave camp again. Trelawny assures Arthur that he'll be back, but Arthur tells him he should just leave and not come back, because everything is hopeless.

main:89.text: Favoured Sons is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. In order to draw attention away from the gang and onto the Natives, Dutch convinces Eagle Flies to ambush an army patrol. Arthur speaks with Dutch, Eagle Flies and a group of Wapiti warriors on a clifftop in Cumberland Forest.

main:90.text: The King's Son is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. Upon learning that Eagle Flies has been captured by the army, Arthur and Charles infiltrate Fort Wallace to rescue him. Arthur meets Charles at the Wapiti Indian Reservation, where Charles asks him to speak to Rains Fall.

main:91.text: The Delights of Van Horn is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. Bill and Arthur ambush an army convoy transporting dynamite through Van Horn. After stealing Leviticus Cornwall's documents during a shootout in Annesburg, Micah learns about some high quality dynamite that is being transported from Annesburg to Saint Denis.

main:92.text: Mrs. Sadie Adler, Widow is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. It is unlocked by 2 or 3 missions, depending on the order in which they are completed: Arthur and Sadie travel to Hanging Dog Ranch to finish business with the O'Driscolls once and for all. Sadie is seen at camp, practicing with throwing knives.

main:93.text: Mrs. Sadie Adler, Widow is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. It is unlocked by 2 or 3 missions, depending on the order in which they are completed: Arthur and Sadie travel to Hanging Dog Ranch to finish business with the O'Driscolls once and for all. Sadie is seen at camp, practicing with throwing knives.

main:94.text: The Bridge to Nowhere is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. John and Arthur plant dynamite on the Bacchus Bridge in order to create a distraction and disrupt the army's transportation. Arthur meets John at Bacchus Bridge, where they are given the job of attaching dynamite to the bridge and blowing it up.

main:95.text: This is the antepenultimate mission of the sixth chapter. Eagle Flies rides into Beaver Hollow to rally a war party for the final raid on Cornwall Kerosene & Tar. Against his father, Chief Rains Fall's wishes. Dutch and the gang then accompany Eagle Flies into battle against the U.S. Army. Arthur meets Dutch outside of his tent, where there is a small gathering.

main:96.text: Our Best Selves is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. This is the penultimate mission of the game's sixth chapter, and the final mission that the player can free roam as protagonist Arthur Morgan beforehand. As their final job, the gang ride to Saint Denis to intercept and rob a train carrying army supplies and payroll, headed for the recently destroyed Bacchus Bridge.

main:97.text: Red Dead Redemption is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. It is the final mission of Chapter 6 and also the final mission in which the player controls the primary protagonist, Arthur Morgan. With John assumed dead, and Abigail captured by Pinkertons, Dutch cuts them loose, and rides for Beaver Hollow. Arthur and Sadie head to Van Horn to rescue Abigail.

main:98.text: Several years after fleeing Dutch and the gang, John, Abigail and Jack look for work in the town of Strawberry. The Marston family rides a wagon through Big Valley after fleeing an incident in which John allegedly shot a man. As they travel, John and his family discuss their uncertain future before deciding to head to Strawberry, where they hope to keep a low profile.

main:99.text: Using the pseudonym "Jim Milton," John has secured a job as a hand at Pronghorn Ranch, and gets to work. John enters the blacksmith's shop at Pronghorn Ranch, where he meets with the ranch foreman, Tom Dickens, and owner David Geddes.

main:100.text: Farming, For Beginners is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. John works a day at the ranch, helping to build a fence, and looking after livestock. Tom Dickens is seen building a fence and asks John to help him. He talks with John and shows him how to build the fence. Tom tells John that he has to get back to work and leaves John to build the remaining sections of the fence. John continues to work throughout the day.

main:101.text: Fatherhood, For Beginners is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. With the other ranch hands busy, and Geddes heading in to town, John takes on more work on the ranch. John finds David Geddes talking to Abe about the amount of work to be done and a lack of ranch hands on duty. Geddes asks John to help his wife and his youngest son Duncan while Abe searches for some missing horses.

main:102.text: A gang of hired-guns cause trouble on Pronghorn Ranch. John wakes up one morning on the ranch to hear a commotion outside. He heads out to see two Laramie Gang members and the leader of the gang terrorizing and harassing Abe. John threatens the gang leader, which leads to a fistfight. John nearly wins the brawl, but is stopped before doing so by Abigail.

main:103.text: Fatherhood, For Idiots is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. John juggles fatherhood and his multiple identities as he heads to Strawberry with Jack to collect mail for Geddes, and a package for Abigail. Upon returning home, John complains to Abigail about how he's struggling to cope with working as a ranch hand as all his skills are criminal.

main:104.text: John is thanked by Mr. Geddes for his help with the Laramie Gang, and John turns in for the night, only to be woken by a raid on the ranch. During the night, the Laramie Gang conducts a raid on the ranch, setting fire to stables and buildings and stealing cattle. Mr. Geddes asks John, Tom and Abe to get his cattle back. John mounts his horse with his guns and rides for Hanging Dog Ranch, the base of the gang.

main:105.text: At Pronghorn Ranch, John receives a telegram from Sadie Adler, asking him to meet her at the saloon in Valentine. Surprised to hear from his old friend, John returns to his cabin to tell Abigail about the message, only to discover that she and Jack have left. He finds a note left by Abigail explaining that she has taken Jack and left the ranch.

main:106.text: Gainful Employment is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. After receiving a telegram from Sadie Adler, John Marston meets her in Valentine and helps her with some bounty hunting work. John finds Sadie in Smithfield's Saloon, in a quarrel with two other patrons who are harassing her.

main:107.text: The Landowning Classes is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. It is one of the few missions in the game to be presented entirely by a single cutscene. Mr. Geddes gave a credit reference to use at the bank in Blackwater. John knocks on the wall outside Atherton's office after the bank clerk directs him there. Atherton looks up and asks what he wants.

main:108.text: Home of the Gentry? is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. Before he can purchase Beecher's Hope, John must inspect the land and move on any illegal tenants. Back in Blackwater, he runs into an old friend.

main:109.text: Bare Knuckle Friendships is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. Uncle tells John that he has heard that Charles Smith is alive and in Saint Denis. John and Uncle go to Saint Denis to track him down. At Beecher's Hope, John visits Uncle, who is lazing around inside the shack. After being berated for his laziness, Uncle reveals that Charles Smith is alive and in Saint Denis.

main:110.text: An Honest Day's Labors is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. John meets Sadie in Blackwater. Sadie asks John to help her recover a bounty named Shane Finley who was taken from her by a professional rival, James Langton. John meets Sadie in the Blackwater saloon, asking if she has any work.

main:111.text: Home Improvement for Beginners is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. John, Uncle and Charles tear down the derelict shack at Beecher's Hope. The mission is initiated when John joins Uncle and Charles at the campfire just outside of his newly-bought shack on Beecher's Hope.

main:112.text: The Tool Box is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. John purchases a pre-cut house from the Blackwater lumberyard. Hearing the Skinner Brothers are in the area, John, Charles, and two hired guns bring the lumber home via the toolmaker at Manzanita Post. In Blackwater, John goes to Cakes Hardwood & Timber to purchase a pre-cut house from Albert Cakes. Then he must visit Manzanita Post to get the necessary tools.

main:113.text: A New Jerusalem is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. John puts together his pre-cut ranch house with the help of Charles and the encouragement of Uncle. John, Charles and Uncle decide to work together to assemble the house. Uncle uses his 'terminal lumbago' as an excuse to get out of doing the actual work and instead contents himself with giving the orders.

main:114.page: A Quick Favor for an Old Friend
main:114.text: A Quick Favor for an Old Friend is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. With his debts mounting and a barn to buy, John accompanies Sadie to hunt down the wanted criminal, Ramón Cortez, and bring him to justice. John finds Uncle resting under a tree. John yells at Uncle for being lazy and Uncle asks John if he believes in reincarnation and John states that he does not believe in that.

main:115.text: Uncle's Bad Day is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. Uncle, John and Charles spend the night celebrating after finishing work on the barn. John and Charles wake to find that Uncle has been taken by the Skinner Brothers. The two must then find and rescue him from the extremely violent gang.

main:116.text: The Best of Women is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. After months of separation, Jack and Abigail finally arrive at the ranch. While John is doing his everyday work, his wife and son, who have left him because of various incidents some time before, finally reunite with him and are impressed by the house he built with Uncle and Charles.

main:117.text: A Really Big Bastard is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. Sadie visits John at Beecher's Hope. They leave to hunt down a bounty, Marshall Thurwell, in Tall Trees and discuss other men who have evaded their capture. With his family now reunited at Beecher's Hope, John enters the living room to find Abigail knitting, one morning.

main:118.text: Trying Again is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. John takes Jack fishing with the family dog, Rufus. They catch more than they bargained for. John finds Jack reading, and playing with the dog, Rufus. He asks Jack if he would like to go fishing, and Jack relents. They do agree they'd like to do more of this on the way, though.

main:119.text: A New Future Imagined is the penultimate mission of the epilogue and overall storyline in Red Dead Redemption 2. John and Abigail go in to Blackwater to spend some quality time together. John has a question to ask her. The mission starts with Abigail bickering with Uncle about his lousy work ethic.

main:120.text: American Venom is the final mission of the epilogue and concludes the main storyline in Red Dead Redemption 2. Sadie Adler hears that Micah Bell is alive somewhere. With the whereabouts of Cleet known in Strawberry, the gang saddles up looking for revenge.

side:1.page: A Better World, A New Friend
side:1.text: The player finds posters across the map requesting perfect animal carcasses for use in a Wildlife Art Exhibition. The carcasses are to be sent to Ms. L. Hobbs from a Post Office. Picking up the first poster will start the first hunting request from a total of 5. The first four are available from Chapter 2, the fifth list and the rest of the mission can only be completed in the Epilogue.

side:2.text: A Bright Bouncing Boy is a Stranger mission featured in Red Dead Redemption 2. The quest becomes available during Chapter 4. Professor Marko Dragic can be found sitting on a pond in Saint Denis having an outburst. After being introduced, he recruits the protagonist to help him with a new remote-controlled boat that he wishes to showcase for some investors.

side:3.text: A Fine Night For It is a Stranger mission featured in Red Dead Redemption 2. The quest becomes available during Chapter 2. After encountering the Night Folk at least once, a stranger will appear on the road heading into Lagras during the night. A old man is sitting at a camp and tells the player about the Night Folk - a murderous group of killers who roam the Bayou.

side:4.text: Jeremy Gill, a self-proclaimed legendary fisherman, is found fishing off the dock. After he is approached, he asks if the player is interested in an autograph or photograph before leading them inside his cabin to show off his livelihood - selling stuffed fishes. He gives the player a map of all Legendary Fish sites in the world and says he'll pay a handsome price for any that are sent his way.

side:5.text: Deborah MacGuiness introduces herself as a leading amateur paleontologist in the nation. She vents that no university will hire her and have rejected her theories. She tells the protagonist about her career of gathering dinosaur bones. After partially excavating a large hip bone, she offers a reward for finding dinosaur bones throughout the world.

side:6.text: Máximo Cristóbal Valdespino, a self-proclaimed famous explorer, can be found southwest of Horseshoe Overlook. He has apparently travelled to the country to hunt for treasure but wishes to leave the United States the next day. He offers to sell the player a treasure map of the location where the Jack Hall Gang's gold is stashed.

side:7.text: American Dreams is a Stranger mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. The quest becomes available during Chapter 2. A coldblooded murderer is out on the loose in the world. While traveling, the player can come across grisly crime scenes, and collect maps from the murdered victims' severed heads. Collect three partial maps and combine the clue pieces to find the killer's location.

side:8.text: A photographer named Albert Mason is found in a field tending to a camera. The player approaches the man and the two introduce each other as the protagonist stands as a subject in front of Albert's camera.

side:9.text: After being saved from choking on a nut at the party during "The Gilded Cage" story mission, the player can find Algernon at his greenhouse in Saint Denis and initiate the first part of the mission by talking to him. Note: The player does not actually have to save him from choking, another NPC steps in after talking to the mayor. His quest will become available regardless.

side:10.text: An unnamed woman is collecting donations for an expansion of the Quincy Harris Memorial Hall in northwest Saint Denis and wishes to tell Arthur Morgan about it. She requests a donation of $20. If the player donates: If the player chooses to donate money, the player will gain a small boost of honor.

side:11.text: When the player approaches the hut, a fast talker named Francis Sinclair emerges and requests that the player find Rock Carvings. He pulls out a book and shows various examples and say he'd pay handsomely for the locations of them. He gives the player his card and retreats back into his hut. Francis Sinclair offers the player a large sum of money for finding the location of 10 Rock Carvings throughout the world.

side:12.text: The mission begins with the player finding a destroyed caravan in Lemoyne. Beside it is a man called Margaret, a circus performer who dresses as a woman and fights exotic animals. He informs the protagonist his three animals, a zebra, lion and tiger, have escaped and are on the loose. He asks for the player's help to find his missing creatures. The first animal is the zebra, which can be found near Emerald Ranch.

side:13.text: Sometime after "The Gilded Cage", Arthur will receive a letter from Henri Lemieux, the mayor of Saint Denis which can be picked up at any post office. In the letter, Lemieux mentions that Arthur robbed him and would like to meet back at his mansion at night. Upon arriving at the mansion, Lemieux makes it clear that he knows who the protagonist is and that he was robbed during the party.

side:14.text: Dr. Alphonse Renaud is found sitting near the front of the Gray Woolen Mill in Rhodes. After the player greets him, he quickly apologizes for offending him and attempts to flee before the player tells him to clarify why he's acting strangely. The doctor states that his wagon and medical supplies were stolen by a gang.

side:15.text: Proetus and Acrisius are two twins, who are competing over a woman named Helen. They are trying to prove their love and show manliness to Helen. Proetus and his brother Acrisius are seen arguing outside of a store in Valentine. Proetus asks the player to help them prove their courage to Helen. He suggests the player shoots bottles off the top of his and Acrisius' heads, and the player has no choice but to accept.

side:16.text: Outside of Flatneck Station, an excitable man named Phineas T. Ramsbottom gains the attention of the player. He shares his passion for smoking, and that he smokes up to '200 cigarettes in one day'. Not for the cigarettes themselves, but for the collectible cigarette cards that can be found in packs.

side:17.text: The American Inferno, Burnt Out is a is a five-part Stranger mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. Near the Upper Montana River, John Marston meets a man atop a mountain side writing a draft for a new book, and the two have a conversation in which he reveals himself to be Evelyn Miller, one of Dutch's personal idols. He then tells John to meet him at his cabin near Tanner's Reach.

side:18.text: Charles Châtenay can be encountered at Doyle's Tavern, where he asks the player if they could buy him a drink of brandy. Charles and the player start talking while sharing a brandy. He tells the player that he has traveled around the world and painted pictures in various countries. He then gives the player one of his sketches before leaving.

side:19.text: The Iniquities of History is a two part Stranger side-mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. The quest becomes available after completing "An Honest Mistake", during Chapter 3. The mission begins once the player speaks with a man lying on a bench outside of Rhodes Train Station, Jeremiah Compson.

side:20.text: Professor Andrew Bell III meets Arthur and asks him if he knows where he can find a large supply of moonshine. He claims the liquor is not for drinking, but will be used for a 'machine of love'. He promises to pay if 100 gallons can be brought to him. After visiting Alden, the train station clerk in Rhodes, Arthur receives a hot tip on where to find a wagon containing it.

side:21.page: The Noblest of Men, and a Woman
side:21.text: The Noblest of Men, and a Woman is a four-part Stranger side-mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. The quest becomes available during Chapter 2. After the Van der Linde gang sets up camp in Horseshoe Overlook, the player can travel to Valentine.

side:22.page: The Smell of the Grease Paint
side:22.text: When entering the saloon of the Van Horn Trading Post, the protagonist encounters Miss Marjorie and a strong simpleton named Bertram, the leader of a traveling sideshow and one half of the talent, respectively. Bertram loses his temper with the bartender for taking a bottle of alcohol away from him. He begins choking the bartender before attempting to fight the protagonist.

side:23.text: Two escaped, bickering convicts, Sampson Black and Wendell White, have been surviving in the woods just outside Rhodes for a few days with little to no supplies. They ask the player for help, requesting that he remove their wanted posters. There are 5 posters total, one in the train station, one outside the sheriff's office and one on a pole by a yard.

side:24.text: When the player approaches a rock, they are greeted by Hamish Sinclair, who asks for help. He informs the player that his horse, Buell, bucked him off and took his wooden leg with him, asking the player for help retrieving his horse. Once Buell is returned to Hamish, he tells the player that, if they please, they can go fishing with him. The player is able to visit Hamish after one in-game day passes.

side:25.text: The player finds a distressed man named Lemuel, laying beside a bridge. The man is incoherent and repeatedly mentions Butcher Creek (and variations on the name), alongside rambling words like "the darkness" and "it's inside me". The protagonist assumes he is from the Butcher Creek settlement not far to the north, and takes him there.

side:26.page: To the Ends of the Earth
side:26.text: It was first exclusive to PC, but was later made available to consoles (for PS4 on December 13, 2019, and for Xbox One on January 21, 2020). It was added alongside Photo Mode and other previously PC exclusive features. The player is asked by a plant collector, William, to collect four Yarrow for studies.

collectible:1.text: Cigarette Cards are collectibles that can be found throughout the world of Red Dead Redemption 2. The search is sparked after the mission "Smoking and other Hobbies", where you meet Phineas T. Ramsbottom, a determined cartophilist who requests the player's help to find each and every card set. For 100% game completion you only need to find one full set of 12 cards.

collectible:2.text: Dinosaur Bones are collectibles that can be found all across the map in Red Dead Redemption 2. The search is sparked after the mission "A Test of Faith", where the player meets Deborah MacGuiness, an aspiring paleontologist who requests the player to help her in her search for dinosaur bones.

collectible:3.text: Dreamcatchers are one of the types of collectibles in Red Dead Redemption 2. If the player manages to find all dreamcatchers, they will earn the Ancient Arrowhead. This side-quest is needed for the 100% Completion of the game. There are a total of 20 Dreamcatchers. You've discovered Dreamcatchers in the wild. Find all Dreamcatchers to reveal their secret.

collectible:4.text: The search is sparked after the mission "Geology for Beginners", where the player meets Francis Sinclair, who requests the player to help him in his search for rock carvings. There are a total of 10 different rock carvings scattered across the map, and the player needs to find at least one of the rock carvings to achieve 100% game completion.

collectible:5.text: Legendary Animals are exceptionally rare animals that appear in Red Dead Redemption, Red Dead Redemption 2 and Red Dead Online. They are stronger, faster and more profitable than their more common counterparts. Once the player has found and killed one of them, it will never appear again in the same save file.

collectible:6.text: Jeremy Gill, a self-proclaimed legendary fisherman, is found fishing off the dock. After he is approached, he asks if the player is interested in an autograph or photograph before leading them inside his cabin to show off his livelihood - selling stuffed fishes. He gives the player a map of all Legendary Fish sites in the world and says he'll pay a handsome price for any that are sent his way.

collectible:7.text: The High Stakes Treasure Map is a treasure map in Red Dead Redemption 2. The map leading to the treasure is rumored to be cursed and many have died looking for it. There are three maps leading to different locations. The first map can be obtained in a random encounter that will only occur after the player has triggered the stranger mission "All That Glitters".

collectible:8.text: The Poisonous Trail Treasure Map is a treasure map in Red Dead Redemption 2. The first map is hidden up in the northwest of Ambarino, on the outskirts of Cairn Lake in the Cairn Lodge. The map can be found in a lockbox under a bed next to the door. The second map is found in Scarlett Meadows, just west of Ringneck Creek in Lemoyne, near Face Rock on the left side of the road northwest of Hill Haven Ranch.

collectible:9.text: The Jack Hall Gang was an outlaw gang mentioned in Red Dead Redemption 2. The Jack Hall gang is an infamous gang that started robbing banks in California until they eventually reached New Hanover. They had buried stolen gold which they planned to retrieve, but they were all killed before this could happen. The player can find the gold with a treasure map.

easter-egg:1.text: The Strange Man is a minor character and a stranger featured in Red Dead Redemption and as a cameo in Red Dead Redemption 2. An enigmatic and otherworldly character, the Strange Man appears to know John Marston very well, including details about his past life in the Van der Linde gang that not even John himself remembers. According to him, he is "in a way" an accountant.

easter-egg:4.text: Vampire (also known as the Saint Denis Vampire) is a minor character and an Easter egg featured in Red Dead Redemption 2. In order to find the Vampire, the player must find five pieces of mysterious writing that line the walls of Saint Denis. These can be found and inspected in any order by the player, after which the protagonist jots down the text and location in their journal.

easter-egg:6.text: Agnes Dowd is a character in the Red Dead series, appearing as a minor character and a special character featured in Red Dead Redemption 2. According to the cries of her spectral form, Agnes fell in love with a man that her parents did not approve of, and would meet him by an old tree in Bluewater Marsh for secret trysts.

easter-egg:7.text: The Giant is an unseen minor character and a special character featured in Red Dead Redemption 2. Not much is known about the giant, other than the fact that he lives in a cave just east of Fairvale Shanty in the Grizzlies East region of Ambarino, and that he is very lonely. The player can encounter the giant, who speaks to the character from behind a closed-off cave entrance that is inaccessible to the player.

easter-egg:8.text: This location is situated east of Brandywine Drop and north of Roanoke Valley. The Meteor House is a cabin on a cliff that overlooks Roanoke Valley in Roanoke Ridge, New Hanover. This point of interest features a stone cottage and a small outhouse behind it. Surrounding the house are things such as a shovel, a bundle of firewood, barrels and other gardening tools. The property is encircled by a wooden fence.
